question: In which year did the first IPL (Indian Premier League) cricket tournament take place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2008**__.

**__Key Points__**

• The **Indian Premier League (IPL)** is a professional **Twenty20 cricket league** in India, and its inaugural tournament took place in the year **2008**. The options **2005**, **2007**, and **2010** are incorrect because the league was not operational in **2005**, it was only conceptualized in **2007**, and **2010** was the year of the third edition.

• The league was officially founded by the **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)** in **2007**. The decision was influenced by India's success in the inaugural **ICC World Twenty20** in **2007**, which sparked massive interest in the shortest format of the game.
